title: Transfer Small Molecules Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: P20 8-Channel Pipette (GEN2) will pick up tips.
Steps 1-5 will repeat for each column/destination plate.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select the P20‑Multi mount, specify the number of destination plates, set the transfer volume (µL) and choose whether to perform the optional Mix with P300‑Multi step.

steps.title: Pick up P20 tips
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette, attach a fresh tip set.

steps.title: Mix library with P20
steps.instruction: Mix the small‑molecule library in each corresponding column using the P20 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Transfer 1 µL to assay
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 µL from the corresponding column of the Small Molecule Library Plate to the same column of the destination plate with the P20 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Discard P20 tips
steps.instruction: Eject the used P20 tips into the waste bin.

steps.title: Optional mix with P300
steps.instruction: If the Mix with P300‑Multi option is set to Yes, mix each column using the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip set on the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette.
Aspirate and dispense 200 µL in the column, repeating the mix three times.
Discard the P300 tips into the waste bin.

steps.title: Repeat for all columns
steps.instruction: Perform steps 2 through 6 for every column of each destination plate.
